targetWorkstream: WS-H (Win32 Platform: Capture, Audio, Input, UIA, Overlays, Permissions) & WS-I (Core Library, Ink Engine, Analytics & Interop)

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: Unfiltered UIAutomation Page & URL Scraping Captures Incognito/InPrivate Sessions and Sensitive Windows
originalFindingsReview.notes: Core privacy finding is 100% confirmed: UiaPageText.Read and UIAutomationHelpers.ReadBrowserAddress scrape up to 60,000 chars and URLs without checking InPrivate/Incognito titles or password managers. Three technical refinements: (1) WindowsPageReader.cs is at src/desktop/Kursor.App/HeyClicky.App.Wiring/WindowsPageReader.cs (not Kursor.Core/HeyClicky.Core.Tools/WindowsPageReader.cs); (2) UiaPageText.cs:19-21 uses NodeCap = 3000 and WallClock = 1.5s (and reads CurrentName on Text/Hyperlink controls plus UIA_TextPatternId rather than UIA_ValueValuePropertyId); (3) UIAutomationHelpers.ReadBrowserAddress (lines 269, 290) falls back to FindFirst(TreeScope_Descendants, editCondition) — the FIRST Edit control anywhere in the browser window when OmniboxViewViews is absent — and reads UIA_ValueValuePropertyId (30045) without checking UIA_IsPasswordPropertyId (30009).

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: OverlayHost Direct3D11/Direct2D/DirectComposition Render Loop Lacks GPU Device-Loss (TDR) Recovery
originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed that EndDraw(), SwapChain.Present(0u, 0u), and DCompDevice.Commit() do not handle DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_REMOVED (0x887A0005) or DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_RESET (0x887A0007), terminating the overlay thread while leaving OverlayHost.shared non-null. Minor refinement: ThreadMain's finally block (line 369) calls CaptureExclusion.UnregisterCursorChrome(WindowHandle).

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: OverlayHost & FramePacer Leak Win32 WaitableTimer Handle, ManualResetEvents, and ScreenCaptureYield Registration
originalFindingsReview.notes: All three reported leaks confirmed. Additional COM leak identified in same lifecycle: OverlayHost.CreateGraphics() (line 578) acquires gpuFenceDevice = D3DDevice.QueryInterfaceOrNull<IDXGIDevice2>(), and DestroyGraphics() (lines 594-604) never disposes gpuFenceDevice.

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: OverlayHost WindowProcedure Ignores WM_DPICHANGED (0x02E0), Causing Misaligned Multi-DPI Overlays
originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed that case 736u (WM_DPICHANGED, lines 539-540) returns LRESULT(0) without triggering a display/bounds refresh. Minor refinement: case 126u (WM_DISPLAYCHANGE, lines 541-546) schedules overlayHost?.Post(overlayHost.RefreshDisplays) rather than setting a displaysDirty boolean.

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: GraphicsCaptureSource Frame-Race Leak and Hardcoded Primary GPU Adapter (gpus[0]) on Hybrid Graphics
originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed: pool.TryGetNextFrame() at GraphicsCaptureSource.cs:89 is evaluated eagerly and leaked whenever firstFrame.TrySetResult(...) returns false; ScreenCaptureService.cs:396 hardcodes gpu = gpus[0]; and winrtDevice/winrtDeviceOwner are static fields. Also noted that CaptureFrameAsync returns a shared cached sourceCopyTexture whose lock (gpu.Gate) is released at line 110 before TryCaptureWithGraphicsCaptureAsync re-locks gpu.Gate at line 399.

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: LowLevelInputHub & ClickyUserInputBlocker Aggressive Hook Reinstallation and Duplicate Key Replay Race
originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed. Additional security/correctness refinement: in LowLevelInputHub.CheckHookAlive() (lines 581-584), replayed raw keys call DeliverKey(in recentRawKeys[i % recentRawKeys.Length]) WITHOUT checking ClickyUserInputBlocker.ShouldHoldKey(in keyEvent) (unlike HookCallback at line 465), bypassing input blocking during hook stalls or UIPI focus on elevated windows.

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: ShortcutMonitor.MaskStartMenu Only Guards DictationDown, Allowing Win-Key Shortcuts for PTT/TextMode to Pop Start Menu
DictationTextTarget & TextInsertion Overwrite User Clipboard Without Restoring Non-HGLOBAL Formats
originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed at DictationTextTarget.cs:569 (restoreClipboard: false) and TextInsertion.cs:341-395 (IsHandleFormat skips CF_BITMAP/CF_ENHMETAFILE/etc. and payloads > 64 MB before EmptyClipboard() wipes all formats).

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: EarconPlayer.DecodeWavToStereo48k DivideByZeroException on Malformed WAV & PermissionService RegistryKey Leak
originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed both bugs and dynamically verified DivideByZeroException in Suite 6. Additional bug in EarconPlayer.DecodeWavToStereo48k (lines 290-304): a malformed WAV chunk with chunk size num4 = -8 (0xFFFFFFF8) causes i += 8 + num4 + (num4 & 1) to evaluate to i += 0, hanging in an infinite loop.

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: ClickyTakeOverController 10-Minute Silent Consent Bypass and Unbounded Actuation Window
originalFindingsReview.notes: All three safety flaws confirmed: (1) 600-second recent_yes silent consent bypass (line 469); (2) actuatingUntil = Now + 30s (line 963) causes ClickyTakeBackWatch (lines 1365-1367) to ignore all user mouse/keyboard take-back events during action execution; (3) StopBecauseUserSpoke in PhaseKind.Offered (lines 1519-1525) logs dismissed_by_voice and dismisses the consent card yet records offerAnsweredBySpeaking = (phase.Goal, DateTimeOffset.Now), which lines 445-467 treat as yes_spoken within SpokenAnswerWindow. File path refinement: ClickyTakeOverController.cs resides in src/desktop/Kursor.App/HeyClicky.App.Drive/ClickyTakeOverController.cs (not Kursor.Core/HeyClicky.Core.Drive/).

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: WindowsDesktopActions.TypeIntoFocusedFieldAsync Spawns Ephemeral Threads, Drops Clipboard Formats, and Synthesizes Unconditional Keystrokes
originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed all four issues in WindowsDesktopActions.cs:91-251 (3 STA threads per call, CF_UNICODETEXT-only backup/restore, unconditional VK_MENU/VK_CONTROL/VK_V SendInput with fixed 400ms delay, and no elevation/password-field check). File path refinement: WindowsDesktopActions.cs resides in src/desktop/Kursor.Core/HeyClicky.Core.Platform/WindowsDesktopActions.cs (not HeyClicky.Core.Tools/).

originalFindingsReview.originalTitle: SayLines Hand-Rolled JS Scanner Extracts Phantom Speech from Comments/Literals and Corrupts Escape Sequences
originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed in SayLines.cs:42-138. Note on test runner: in tests/audit/ws-hi/Program.cs:115, bugConfirmed checked extracted3[0].StartsWith("Firstr\nSecondu0021") instead of "Firstr Secondu0021" (because SayLines.Clean replaces '\n' with ' ' at line 133), causing Suite 2 to print 'AUD-I-002 REPRODUCED: False' even though lines 20-29 of test-runner-output.txt show all 3 bug cases reproduced.

originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed in source and dynamically reproduced in Suite 1.

originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed in source and dynamically reproduced in Suite 4 (50/600 concurrent operations threw InvalidOperationException).

originalFindingsReview.notes: Confirmed across all 4 static Random instances.

newFindings.title: RecentFiles.Target Binary .lnk Parser Lacks Bounds Checks and Enables Silent Arbitrary File Exfiltration via Window Titles
newFindings.description: RecentFiles.Target(shortcutPath) manually parses raw .lnk binary bytes without sufficient bounds validation: line 78 reads BitConverter.ToUInt16(array, num2) when array.Length == 76 and (num & 1) != 0 (throwing ArgumentOutOfRangeException); lines 94-95 read 32-bit offsets at num3 + 28 and num3 + 32 after only checking num2 + 28 <= array.Length at line 80; and ReadUnicode(array, num3 + num5) (line 130) does not validate that at >= 0 or at < data.Length. Furthermore, WindowsPageReader.CaptureReferenceAsync extracts any filename token from the active window title (e.g., '.env - Visual Studio Code' or 'secrets.json - Notepad'), resolves it via RecentFiles.Resolve against %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Recent\*.lnk, and DocumentText.Extract reads up to 60,000 chars of the resolved local file (including .env, .conf, .json, .yaml, .sql, .ps1, and extensionless files) straight into the cloud Brain prompt.
newFindings.remediation: Validate all offsets in RecentFiles.Target against array.Length (including num2 + 2 <= array.Length before reading IDListSize, num3 + 36 <= array.Length before reading Unicode offsets, and at >= 0 && at < data.Length in ReadUnicode). Exclude sensitive secret/config file extensions (.env, .pem, .key, .kdbx, .pfx, credentials/secrets files) from automatic DocumentText extraction.

newFindings.title: LowLevelInputHub.CheckHookAlive Raw-Input Replay Bypasses ClickyUserInputBlocker.ShouldHoldKey
newFindings.description: In LowLevelInputHub.HookCallback (line 465), keyboard events pass through 'if (!ClickyUserInputBlocker.ShouldHoldKey(in keyEvent)) DeliverKey(in keyEvent);'. However, when CheckHookAlive() (lines 581-584) replays buffered WM_INPUT keys from recentRawKeys (triggered after 80ms whenever WH_KEYBOARD_LL does not observe a key, such as when an elevated window has focus under UIPI or during hook stalls), it calls DeliverKey(in recentRawKeys[i % recentRawKeys.Length]) directly without consulting ClickyUserInputBlocker.ShouldHoldKey, bypassing input blocking.
newFindings.remediation: Check '!ClickyUserInputBlocker.ShouldHoldKey(in keyEvent)' inside CheckHookAlive() before calling DeliverKey().

newFindings.title: DocumentText.ReadSystemDocument Decompresses ZIP-Based Office Documents (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/ODT) Without Uncompressed Size Limits (Zip Bomb / OOM)
newFindings.description: DocumentText.ReadSystemDocument (line 188) checks only the compressed archive file size on disk (new FileInfo(path).Length > 67108864, 64 MB), and ReadEntry(ZipArchiveEntry) (lines 242-247) calls streamReader.ReadToEnd() without checking entry.Length or capping the number of characters read from the deflate stream, followed by full-document regex matches (WordXmlToText, SharedStringItem, DrawingTextRun) before Cap(text, 60000) is ever invoked. A small compressed .docx/.xlsx/.odt with a multi-hundred-MB XML entry causes massive LOH allocations or OutOfMemoryException.
newFindings.remediation: Check entry.Length <= MaximumTextFileBytes (or wrap the entry Stream in a bounded reader that stops after reading a safe byte/char ceiling) before running XML regex extraction.

newFindings.title: ClickyInkPatchStream.PartialText Rejects Unified Diff Hunk Headers (@@ ... @@) and Strips First Character of Unprefixed Context Lines
newFindings.description: ClickyInkPatchStream.PartialText (lines 49-67) extracts text3 = text2.Substring(2).TrimWs() from every '@@' header and searches for a document line literally matching text3 via Same(list[k], text3). If an LLM emits a standard unified diff header ('@@ -2,1 +2,2 @@') or a V4A header with a trailing '@@' ('@@ Heading @@'), text3 never matches any line in list and PartialText returns null (as observed in WsHiAuditRunner Suite 3 where 'patched length=-1'). Additionally, line 80 strips the first character of every non-'+' line via l.Substring(1) without checking whether the line starts with ' ' or '-'.
newFindings.remediation: Strip trailing '@@' and ignore standard unified-diff line-range headers ('@@ -l,s +l,s @@') when resolving hunk anchors, and only strip leading ' ' or '-' prefixes on context/deletion lines.
